view.title: Mobile Test Automation LLM Pipeline - Container view (logical components)
view.caption: This view opens the Mobile Test Automation LLM Pipeline system box from the Context view at logical-component grain: the sixteen components in three clusters, the shared screening library that is deliberately not a component, and the external systems they touch. Edges carry numbers; the numbered edge-detail table resolves each claim.

nodes.label: Coordinate Conversion
detail: Advances each conversion through its explicit state transitions within its retry budgets.
Maximally unstable: CE = 11, CA = 0, I = 1.00 - the structural weak point, carried to Stage 4 as ADR-3 (central orchestration vs event-driven choreography).

nodes.label: Ingest Test Sources
detail: Acquires manual-test payloads and their source references from Octane, ALM/QC, and Excel.
One of three trust boundaries that invoke the screening library.

nodes.label: Interpret Test Intent
detail: Produces schema-valid TestCaseIR, including control flow, and flags ambiguity rather than resolving it silently.
Enriches with control flow and step dependencies - the defensible half of pass-1's 'Planner'.

nodes.label: Acquire UI Evidence
detail: Captures and prunes page-source and Object Spy evidence from a live Perfecto device.
One implementation, two callers (human in Phase 1, service in Phase 2). One of three trust boundaries invoking the screening library.

nodes.label: Resolve Elements
detail: Ranks and validates locator candidates against captured evidence and the object repository.
Owns the locator cascade - nothing else may know it. Watch item: if VLM grounding is adopted, extract Ground Visually (section 6).

nodes.label: Retrieve Conversion Assets
detail: Supplies the versioned prompts, house rules, and exemplars a conversion step requires.
Stable; version identity is its whole job. CE = 1, CA = 4, I = 0.20.

nodes.label: Generate Test Code
detail: Renders Page Objects and Appium Java/TestNG tests from approved IR and locators.
Growth test: if house-style rework churns independently of code generation, extract Match House Style (section 5).

nodes.label: Repair Locators
detail: Re-grounds locators for heal-eligible failures within a bounded repair budget.
Budget: 3 static repairs, 3 device retries, then human queue (enforced by the coordinator).

nodes.label: Invoke Models
detail: Mediates every model call with versioned prompts, fixed sampling policy, caching, and backoff.

Single choke point. Stable and abstract: CE = 1, CA = 5, I = 0.17. Cache-key defect (must include model and provider version) carried to Stage 4 as ADR-2. One of three trust boundaries invoking the screening library.

nodes.label: Route Human Decisions
detail: Presents ambiguous and sub-threshold cases for decision and records the outcome attributably.
Human/identity boundary; balanced CE = 1, CA = 1, I = 0.50.

nodes.label: Verify Statically
detail: Rejects generated code that fails formatting, compilation, lint, or locator-manifest rules.
Free, fast, deterministic; runs on every generation. One of the three components that 'LLM-free replay' now refers to (section 8).

nodes.label: Replay on Devices
detail: Executes committed tests K times against pinned Perfecto capability sets.
The system's dominant cost; inherently flaky; rate-limited by lab capacity. K=3 conversion, K=5 certification.

nodes.label: Classify Replay Outcome
detail: Assigns a rule-based failure class to each run and emits the ReplayReport.
Must stay deterministic and rule-based; explicitly not LLM work. Owns the failure-class taxonomy enum.

nodes.label: Certify Conversion
detail: Grades assertion fidelity against the original manual expected result, applies the admission gates conjunctively, and issues the certification verdict.

The one genuinely divergent component in pass 3: gate application is deterministic; fidelity grading is nondeterministic. CE = 4 (was 2), CA = 1, I = 0.80. Growth trigger: re-extract Judge Semantic Fidelity if recalibration decouples from gate-rule change. Carried to Stage 4 as ADR-4.

nodes.label: Publish Certified Assets
detail: Writes certified locators and tests to the object repository and the exemplar corpus under single-writer discipline.
Both writes must succeed or neither is visible; balanced CE = 1, CA = 1, I = 0.50.

nodes.label: Preserve Provenance
detail: Maintains the append-only lineage linking source asset, IR, prompt and model version, code commit, run artifacts, and human decisions - and exposes a read model over that lineage for conversion, quality, and cost metrics.

Maximally stable and the most-depended-on contract: CE = 0, CA = 13, I = 0.00. The pass-3 read model is versioned separately so a metrics change cannot churn the write contract. Also owns the read-only auditor export (ADR 0008).

nodes.label: screening library
detail: Shared screening library - injection screening plus secret/PII redaction - invoked at all three trust boundaries.

Demoted from a component at the pass-3 gate; the duplication rule is still satisfied but the boundary is no longer structural, so its three call sites must be asserted by a fitness function (section 4, section 9).

nodes.label: Octane / ALM-QC / Excel
detail: External manual-test source systems, drawn as EXT1 in the section 10 component diagram.

nodes.label: Perfecto device lab
detail: External device lab, drawn as EXT2; touched by Acquire UI Evidence and Replay on Devices.

nodes.label: Orchestrator AI gateway
detail: External model provider, drawn as EXT3; reached only through Invoke Models.

nodes.label: object repository
detail: External store, drawn as EXT4; read by Resolve Elements, written by Publish Certified Assets.

nodes.label: Git prompt and exemplar corpus
detail: External store, drawn as EXT5; read by Retrieve Conversion Assets, grown by Publish Certified Assets.

nodes.label: QA engineers and reviewers
detail: The human actor from the Context view, drawn as EXT6 in the section 10 component diagram; the endpoint of Route Human Decisions.

edges.detail: Coordinate Conversion drives Ingest Test Sources (orchestrator fan-out, CE = 11).
Coordinate Conversion drives Interpret Test Intent.
Coordinate Conversion drives Acquire UI Evidence.
Coordinate Conversion drives Resolve Elements.
Coordinate Conversion drives Generate Test Code.
Coordinate Conversion drives Verify Statically.
Coordinate Conversion drives Replay on Devices.
Coordinate Conversion drives Classify Replay Outcome.
Coordinate Conversion drives Repair Locators.
Coordinate Conversion drives Certify Conversion.
Coordinate Conversion routes to Route Human Decisions - the asynchronous edge in the middle of the state machine (section 6).
Interpret Test Intent calls Invoke Models for messy free text.
Resolve Elements calls Invoke Models.
Generate Test Code calls Invoke Models.
Repair Locators calls Invoke Models for bounded re-grounding.
Interpret Test Intent retrieves conversion assets.
Resolve Elements retrieves conversion assets.
Generate Test Code retrieves conversion assets (exemplars, skeletons).
Repair Locators reuses Resolve Elements - the reuse that justified withdrawing pass-1's Fix Proposer (section 8).
Certify Conversion hands a passed verdict to Publish Certified Assets.
Certify Conversion retrieves conversion assets - new efferent edge in pass 3.

entanglement: cluster B calls cluster A. Certify Conversion calls Invoke Models to grade fidelity - Dynamic Quantum Entanglement, the one edge crossing from cluster B back into cluster A (section 1a, section 10). Carried to Stage 4 as ADR-4.

Ingest Test Sources invokes the screening library at its trust boundary (drawn as a dashed boundary edge in the section 10 source; rendered solid here because the source does not assert asynchrony and dashed is reserved for async).
Acquire UI Evidence invokes the screening library at its trust boundary.
Invoke Models invokes the screening library at its trust boundary.
Ingest Test Sources writes to the append-only provenance contract (all 13 write edges into Preserve Provenance carry the same lineage-append semantics).
Interpret Test Intent writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Acquire UI Evidence writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Resolve Elements writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Generate Test Code writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Repair Locators writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Invoke Models writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Verify Statically writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Replay on Devices writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Classify Replay Outcome writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Certify Conversion writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Publish Certified Assets writes lineage to Preserve Provenance.
Route Human Decisions writes human corrections as preference pairs to Preserve Provenance - flywheel input.
Ingest Test Sources reads from Octane / ALM-QC / Excel (EXT1).
Acquire UI Evidence captures evidence from the Perfecto device lab (EXT2).
Replay on Devices runs K replays against the Perfecto device lab (EXT2).
Invoke Models reaches the Orchestrator AI gateway (EXT3) - the single model-call seam.
Resolve Elements looks up known elements in the object repository (EXT4).
Publish Certified Assets writes certified locators/tests back to the object repository (EXT4).
Retrieve Conversion Assets reads versioned prompts/exemplars from the Git corpus (EXT5).
Publish Certified Assets grows the exemplar/golden set in the Git corpus (EXT5).
Route Human Decisions presents cases to QA engineers and reviewers (EXT6).
